user.title: Add appliance
user.description: Monitor an appliance through the power sensor on its plug. Cycles are detected from its power usage and used to estimate when future cycles will end.

data_description.power_entity: Power sensor (W) for the appliance's plug. Prefer the unfiltered sensor: smoothing filters lag and hold their last value after the appliance switches off.
data_description.programs: Program names to label cycles with, e.g. Cottons, Eco. You can add more later.

reconfigure.title: Change power sensor
reconfigure.description: Recorded cycles are kept, so pick a sensor measuring the same appliance.

data_description.power_entity: Power sensor (W) for the appliance's plug. Prefer the unfiltered sensor: smoothing filters lag and hold their last value after the appliance switches off.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already monitored.

data_description.start_power: A cycle starts once power has been at or above this for the start delay. Dips shorter than the start delay, like drum pauses, don't reset it.
data_description.end_power: A cycle ends when power stays below this for the end delay. Make the delay longer than any pause mid-cycle.
data_description.stale_timeout: If the sensor sends nothing for this long, treat power as 0 W from its last update. 0 disables.
data_description.finished_timeout: How long the state stays finished before returning to idle. 0 keeps it until the next cycle.
data_description.max_power: Readings above this, and any below 0 W, are ignored as glitches. Some plugs occasionally report huge values such as 107374182.4 W. Set it above the most the appliance can draw. 0 disables.

forget_cycle.name: Forget cycle
forget_cycle.description: Deletes a recorded cycle so it's no longer used for matching, e.g. one that was cut short or mislabelled.

config_entry_id.name: Appliance
config_entry_id.description: The Power Monitor entry the cycle belongs to.

cycle_id.name: Cycle ID
cycle_id.description: ID of the cycle, from the cycles attribute of the Recorded cycles sensor.

entry_not_loaded.message: Power Monitor entry {entry_id} was not found or isn't loaded.
